sig: [[["A", "Thanks, everyone. Let's move on to our results for the third quarter."], ["A", "Overall, it was a strong quarter. Total revenue reached four point two million dollars, up eight percent from the second quarter."], ["A", "Most of that growth came from our cloud services, which now make up nearly half of our sales."], ["A", "Our mobile app subscriptions also did well, especially in Japan and Australia."], ["A", "On the other hand, hardware sales dropped by about five percent."], ["A", "That wasn't a big surprise, since we stopped producing two older models in July."], ["A", "We also kept costs under control, mainly by reducing travel and moving more meetings online."], ["A", "As a result, our profit margin improved slightly."], ["A", "Looking ahead, we expect the fourth quarter to be even busier, with the holiday season and two major product launches."], ["A", "I'll send the full report to everyone by end of day, so please take a look before our planning session on Monday."], ["A", "Now, let's open it up for questions."]], {"A": "M-US"}]
